versions.changelog:
- Initial release of audio-summary skill.
- Extracts 16k mono audio from video files using ffmpeg.
- Transcribes audio to text and generates content summaries using the Qwen3 ASR Flash model.
- Supports video files up to approximately 5-8 minutes after compression.
- Summaries are saved as .txt files in the same directory as the source video.
- Requires ffmpeg, openai Python SDK, and a configured Baichuan API key.
